parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is one of the two switch buttons on the wall switch, made of durable ABS plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main interface for toggling the electrical circuit on or off.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots or depresses slightly when pressed, returning to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the second switch button on the wall switch, also made of ABS plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It controls a separate electrical circuit or light, functioning independently from the first switch.
parts.Movement_description: It moves similarly to the first switch, pivoting or depressing when pressed.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or mounting plate of the wall switch, made of polycarbonate for strength and insulation.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support for the switches and houses the internal electrical components.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed to the wall and does not move during operation.
